products.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat for Education
products.note: AI: Chat with enterprise data protection. Who: Educators, staff, students 13+. Student age: Students 13 and older only. Privacy: Enterprise data protection under Microsoft 365 Education. Price: Free for educators, staff, and students 13+; Microsoft 365 Copilot is a paid add-on.

products.name: Microsoft Immersive Reader
products.note: AI: Read aloud, word translation in 100+ languages. Who: All students. Student age: Built into Microsoft apps; follows the school's Microsoft 365 accounts. Privacy: Covered by Microsoft 365 Education terms. Price: Free in Word, OneNote, Outlook, Teams, Forms, Edge.

products.name: Microsoft PowerPoint and Teams live captions
products.note: AI: Speech recognition captions. Who: All students. Student age: School Microsoft 365 accounts. Privacy: Microsoft states Live Captions comply with FERPA. Price: Included in Microsoft 365.

products.name: Microsoft Seeing AI
products.note: AI: Scene, text, and object description. Who: Students, adults. Student age: App Store age rating 4+. Privacy: Consumer app; no school agreement. App Store label: identifiers, usage, and diagnostics not linked to identity. Price: Free.

products.name: Microsoft Translator
products.note: AI: Speech and text translation. Who: Teachers, families, students. Student age: Inside Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, OneNote, and Teams it follows the school's Microsoft 365 accounts. Privacy: Translation inside Microsoft 365 apps is no-trace by default (not logged or used for training). The standalone app is a consumer app that may collect content not linked to identity. Price: Free apps on iOS and Android; built into Microsoft 365.

products.name: Microsoft Attack Simulation Training
products.note: Verified in the research for The AI Ready School. AI: Simulated phishing campaigns. Use: Phishing simulation for staff. Who: Staff. Student age: Staff. Privacy: Microsoft 365 terms. Price: Requires Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Plan 2 or E5-level license (included in Microsoft 365 Education A5); 90-day trial available.

products.name: Microsoft Forms
products.note: Found in the research for The AI Ready School; not independently verified. AI: Some AI question suggestions. Use: Surveys and quizzes. Who: Teachers, students. Student age: School Microsoft 365 accounts. Privacy: Microsoft 365 Education terms. Price: Included in the free Microsoft 365 A1 plan (third-party licensing guide).

products.name: Microsoft PowerPoint Designer
products.note: Found in the research for The AI Ready School; not independently verified. AI: Design suggestions. Use: Slide design suggestions. Who: Teachers, students. Student age: School Microsoft 365 accounts. Privacy: Microsoft 365 Education terms. Price: License requirement not verified.

products.name: Microsoft Reading Coach
products.note: Found in the research for The AI Ready School; not independently verified. AI: Speech-based fluency practice. Use: Reading fluency practice with AI stories. Who: Students. Student age: Not verified. Privacy: Included in Microsoft 365 Education Learning Accelerators. Price: Free in Microsoft 365 Education; also offered free with a Microsoft account.

products.name: Microsoft Teams recap
products.note: Found in the research for The AI Ready School; not independently verified. AI: Intelligent recap. Use: AI meeting notes. Who: Staff. Student age: Staff use. Privacy: Microsoft 365 Education terms. Price: Intelligent recap needs a paid Teams Premium or Microsoft 365 Copilot license (Teams Premium about $30 per user per year at one university). Free workaround: live transcript pasted into Copilot Chat. Caution: Not free; affects three ideas.

products.name: Microsoft Word
products.note: Found in the research for The AI Ready School; not independently verified. AI: Dictate, Editor. Use: Word processing. Who: Students, teachers. Student age: School Microsoft 365 accounts. Privacy: Microsoft 365 Education terms. Price: Web and mobile Office apps included in free Microsoft 365 A1 (third-party licensing guide).

products.note: Found in the research for The AI Ready School; not independently verified. AI: Speech to text. Use: Audio transcription in Word. Who: Staff, students. Student age: Not verified.
